feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Pope ends Argentina visit with unity plea after pushing back against Milei's agenda
articles.summary: Pope Leo closed an emotional visit to Argentina with an appeal for unity and reconciliation, offering a message of hope to his predecessor's polarised homeland.

articles.title: Four grizzly bears killed mother and daughter in Canada
articles.summary: Four grizzly bears captured in Canada were responsible for killing a mother and daughter earlier this month, officials have said.

articles.title: Ex-investigator admits depriving war crimes probe of potentially valuable information
articles.summary: A former senior investigating officer for the Royal Military Police has admitted depriving a war crimes investigation of potentially valuable information.

articles.title: UK court overturns Trinidad and Tobago law criminalising homosexual sex
articles.summary: ‌Trinidad and Tobago's ‌law criminalising consensual sexual ​relations between male same-sex couples has been overturned ‌by a ​UK court.

articles.title: Sophie visits refugee camps on trip to Bangladesh
articles.summary: Sophie has visited the Rohingya refugee camps at Cox's Bazar in Bangladesh to see the support being offered to displaced people from Myanmar.

articles.title: Police officer dies and another seriously injured after explosion in northern Spain
articles.summary: One police officer has died and another has lost a leg after an explosive device detonated at the scene of a shooting in northern Spain.

articles.title: At least 12 killed in Bulgaria motorway pile-ups involving dozens of vehicles
articles.summary: At least 12 people have been killed in two motorway pile-ups in eastern Bulgaria, the country's health minister said.

articles.title: FBI investigating Nvidia CEO over affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said the FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy - but insisted he is a "very honourable man".

articles.title: France blames Iran for massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges
articles.summary: France has accused Iran of being behind the massive cyber attack on supermarket fridges last month.

articles.title: At least 14 dead after boat carrying migrants found near Crete
articles.summary: At least 14 people have died after a boat carrying migrants was found near Crete, Greek authorities have said.
